description: SIDRA INTERSECTION, from SIDRA SOLUTIONS, is software for the design and evaluation of individual intersections and networks of intersections. Its Network model is micro-analytical, and version 11 adds SIDRA ASSIGN, which models route choice between origin and destination zones from O-D trip demand, with five assignment methods including stochastic user equilibrium. A SIDRA API lets users' own code run scenarios and build models from their data. Coverage: generic; the site's case examples include metering a roundabout to relieve a queue blocking a freeway interchange, which moved 494 vehicles per hour onto another route. Format and access: desktop software with licences and downloads managed through customer accounts; version 11.0.3.112 was released on 27 July 2026, and training workshops are offered. Licence and cost: commercial. Caveats: an analytical, not stochastic microsimulation model; prices are not shown on the homepage. It supports capacity planning and network flow studies at junction level, such as assessing diversion when an intersection or link is degraded. It relates to HCS, PTV Vissim and Aimsun Next in the catalogue.
